claims.statement: For every finite uniform Boolean cube, every genuine Boolean f(x_A,y_B), and every nontrivial physical cut A|B, the multiplicative rectangle defect rho_A(f) is at most min(I_A(f),I_B(f)).
claims.quantifiers: Every n>=2; every Boolean f:{-1,1}^n->{-1,1}; every nonempty proper A subset [n].
claims.units: probabilities and physical influences under uniform measure
claims.proof_method: Conditional rectangle probability equals Var(r)/2; cube Poincare; pivotality-XOR union bound
scope_exclusions: Does not bound A054's entropy-continuity excess linearly

claims.statement: For every Boolean f and coordinate i, rho_i(f)=I_i(f)(1-I_i(f)). For every physical restriction tree querying a coordinate at most once per path, the reach-probability weighted sum of rho_i at internal nodes is at most I(f), with exact queried-influence telescope I(f)-sum_leaf w_leaf I(f_leaf).
claims.quantifiers: Every finite uniform Boolean cube; every coordinate; every finite nonreusing physical restriction tree.
claims.units: probabilities and physical influences under uniform measure

claims.statement: There exists an absolute C_rect such that every nonconstant descendant-critical tensor-prime Boolean f has an essential coordinate i with Delta_i H(f)<=C_rect I_i(f)(1-I_i(f)).
claims.quantifiers: Proposed for all finite dimensions and every genuine Boolean descendant-critical tensor-prime source.
claims.units: bits for entropy; dimensionless probabilities and ratio
claims.conditional_consequence: Together with A096 critical pruning and A052 tensor-prime reduction, this implies full FEI with C=C_rect.
claims.evidence: NUMERICAL exhaustive floating probe through n=4 gives maximum observed min_i Delta_i H/rho_i=8; not a certificate.
scope_exclusions: Finite evidence does not cover arbitrary n
